headline: Restaurant and hotel prices in Italy are rising faster than inflation
summary: Prices in Italian restaurants and hotels rose noticeably more than inflation would suggest, according to the report. Italy is also a leading holiday destination for Poles this year.
why: Services inflation in hospitality feeds into consumer price trends and tourism revenues that matter for Italian growth and related equities.
